name: Gloaming Deep

stars.name: Gloaming Deep A
stars.notes: Steady orange primary whose close-in habitable zone cradles the colony world Lowlight.

stars.name: Gloaming Deep B
stars.notes: Dim red dwarf bound to C in a tight sub-pair orbiting the primary at 210 AU.

stars.name: Gloaming Deep C
stars.notes: Flare-prone companion; its tantrums paint the outer system in auroral light visible from Lowlight.

planets.name: Emberling
planets.notes: Tidally tortured lava bead skimming the primary; mined once, abandoned twice.

planets.name: Lowlight
planets.notes: Tidally locked colony world whose eternal dusk band hosts grain terraces and the capital, Lamptown.

planets.name: Ferric Step
planets.notes: Iron-rich rock staked by belt miners; robot rigs work its regolith between flare seasons.

planets.name: Longfall
planets.notes: Cold ocean world rimmed by pack ice; storm cells the size of continents never fully dissolve.

planets.name: Pallor
planets.notes: Pale-banded giant skimmed occasionally for helium-3; its moons are mapped but unclaimed.

planets.name: Wintermark
planets.notes: Frozen outlier whose geysers fire whenever the B-C pair flares, a natural flare-warning beacon.

asteroid_belts.name: Cinder Drift
asteroid_belts.notes: Licensed claims feed Lowlight's foundries; the League levies tolls on every outbound ingot.

stations.name: Lanternpost Station
stations.notes: Colony administration hub, customs house, and the only sanctioned port of entry.

stations.name: Deepmoor Rig
stations.notes: Rotating miner crews on ninety-day contracts; dry, loud, and paid in scrip.

faction_control.notes: A charter colony governed by Lowlight's council of landholders; the League keeps two patrol cutters on station.

history: League scouts charted the trinary in the second wave of frontier expansion, drawn by Lowlight's unusually temperate dusk band.
First landing established Lamptown under mirror-light towers; within a decade the colony was shipping grain and forged iron.
Recent B-C pair flare activity has doubled aurora tourism and forced a costly rework of the Cinder Drift mining rotations.
description: Gloaming Deep earns its name honestly: an orange primary hung in perpetual twilight above three worlds, watched over by a distant pair of red dwarfs whose flares set the whole sky shimmering. Six planets thread stable S-type orbits around Gloaming Deep A while the B-C sub-pair circles far outside like a slow red lantern.

The system matters to exactly one thing: Lowlight, the tidally locked colony where all of life gathers in the narrow band between burning day and frozen night. Its grain terraces and foundries supply the surrounding Marches, and Lanternpost Station handles what little trade comes calling. Beyond Lowlight, the belts and ice fields see only contract miners.

Old-timers insist the red pair's flares follow a rhythm tied to nothing yet explained, and Wintermark's geysers answer them with eerie punctuality. The League quietly funds a small observatory tasked with predicting the next great outburst. Settlers joke about it over lamplight, but nobody builds on the night side without checking the forecast.
